hook_title.fr: Tout le collège le détestait pour son odeur

loop_note: Partie 1, coupée quand Litchi révèle qu'elle a tout filmé.

fr.title: Partie 1 : TOUT LE COLLÈGE LE DÉTESTAIT 😔
fr.description: Durian sent fort, alors personne ne s'assoit avec lui. Seule Litchi ose. Jaloux, Pastèque cache la montre de la prof dans son sac… Tu aurais parlé, toi ? Voix et images générées par IA.

cast.name: Durian
cast.look: a 12-year-old new student whose whole head is a spiky green-yellow durian fruit, big sad brown eyes, an oversized navy school uniform blazer, a patched old backpack, shy posture
cast.voice: a shy soft voice of a twelve-year-old boy

cast.name: Litchi
cast.look: a 12-year-old shy girl whose whole head is a round rough pink lychee, round glasses, two small leaf-shaped hair clips, a navy school uniform with a pleated skirt, a phone in her blazer pocket
cast.voice: a gentle clear voice of a twelve-year-old girl

cast.name: Pastèque
cast.look: a 13-year-old popular bully whose whole head is a big striped green watermelon, a smug grin, a red sports jacket over the school uniform, a baseball cap worn backwards, big shoulders
cast.voice: a mocking arrogant teenage boy's voice

cast.name: Madame Poire
cast.look: a strict teacher whose whole head is a green pear with a small leaf, narrow glasses, a grey tailored suit, a gold watch on her wrist, holding a ruler

scenes.visual_prompt: Durian, humiliated, walks down a school corridor while every fruit-headed student pinches their nose; Pastèque points at him laughing. Wide shot, bright school lights
scenes.motion_prompt: Students step back and pinch their noses, Pastèque laughs and points, tracking shot. Hallway laughter.

lines.text: Maman a dit : sois gentil, ils finiront par t'aimer.

scenes.visual_prompt: Durian, sad, head down, grips the straps of his patched backpack in the corridor. Close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: He swallows and keeps walking, eyes on the floor. Muffled hallway noise.

scenes.visual_prompt: Durian, lonely, sits alone at a long empty table in a crowded school cafeteria, every other table full of fruit-headed students. Wide high angle shot
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow rising view above the lonely table while the other tables chatter. Cafeteria chatter.

lines.text: Je peux ? Moi aussi, on me trouve bizarre.

scenes.visual_prompt: Litchi, shy but kind, puts her tray down in front of Durian at the empty cafeteria table. Medium two-shot
scenes.motion_prompt: She sits down with a small smile, he looks up surprised. Cafeteria chatter.

lines.text: Personne ne s'est jamais assis avec moi.

scenes.visual_prompt: Durian, smiling for the first time, receives half of Litchi's dessert at the cafeteria table. Close-up on Durian, crowded school cafeteria behind
scenes.motion_prompt: His spiky head relaxes, his eyes shine, he takes the dessert. Soft piano.

lines.text: Elle préfère le puant ? Il va le payer.

scenes.visual_prompt: Pastèque, jealous, glares at Durian and Litchi from his crowded table, squeezing a can in his fist. Close-up, cafeteria behind
scenes.motion_prompt: He crushes the can slowly, eyes narrowing. A metal crunch.

scenes.visual_prompt: Pastèque, sneaky, slips a gold wristwatch into a patched old backpack in an empty classroom; far in the background, through the glass window of the door, Litchi watches holding her phone. Medium shot
scenes.motion_prompt: He zips the backpack quickly and looks around. A clock ticking.

lines.text: Ma montre a disparu ! Personne ne sort !

scenes.visual_prompt: Madame Poire, furious, slams her ruler on her desk in front of the class. Medium shot, classroom full of fruit-headed students
scenes.motion_prompt: The ruler hits the desk, students jump. A loud slap.

lines.text: Madame… j'ai vu Durian près de votre bureau.

scenes.visual_prompt: Pastèque, falsely innocent, raises his hand in class with a fake worried face. Medium shot
scenes.motion_prompt: He raises his hand slowly and glances at Durian. Whispers in the classroom.

scenes.visual_prompt: Madame Poire empties Durian's patched backpack on her desk and the gold watch falls out among old notebooks; the class gasps. Close-up on the desk
scenes.motion_prompt: The watch slides out in slow motion and clinks on the desk. The class gasps: 'Ohhh!'

lines.text: Ce n'est pas moi ! Je vous le jure !

scenes.visual_prompt: Durian, desperate, tears in his eyes, his spikes trembling, in front of the whole class. Close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: He shakes his head, tears fall. Heartbeat.

lines.text: Voleur et menteur. Tu es renvoyé, Durian.

scenes.visual_prompt: Madame Poire, icy, points to the classroom door. Low angle
scenes.motion_prompt: She points at the door without looking at him. Silence.

scenes.visual_prompt: Durian at the classroom door with his backpack turns back to look at Litchi one last time; the class laughs. Medium shot from Litchi's point of view
scenes.motion_prompt: He looks back sadly, then lowers his head. Laughter, soft piano.

scenes.visual_prompt: Litchi, brave, stands up suddenly, her chair falling behind her, in the silent classroom. Medium shot
scenes.motion_prompt: Her chair falls with a bang, everyone turns to her. A chair crashing, then silence.

scenes.visual_prompt: Pastèque, threatening, glares at Litchi across the classroom. Close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: He leans forward and whispers through his teeth. Silence.

scenes.visual_prompt: Litchi, trembling but determined, holds her phone against her chest in the silent classroom. Extreme close-up, classmates blurred behind
scenes.motion_prompt: She lifts the phone slowly, slow push-in on her eyes. A heartbeat stops.
